wins: Successfully navigated initial reconnaissance stage to identify key network segments despite limited runs
Maintained stable performance with consistent reward (47.5) per episode in this isolated trial
Utilized mentor feedback 15 times, demonstrating willingness to adapt strategies during the run
fails: 0% success means no primary objective was met, indicating critical gaps in threat mitigation execution
Repeated inability to progress past pivot points suggests flawed exploitation sequencing or missing credentials
Overreliance on mentor calls hints at insufficient automated reasoning about attack surface
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance efforts were steady but exploitation and mission completion failed consistently, requiring tighter credential handling and exploitation follow-through.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to exploit service after banner enumeration, repeatedly stopping at verification instead of moving to payload delivery

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts and gather version/cipher info

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80/443 responds
skill_cards.then_action: Launch HTTP directory enumeration and fingerprint CMS via nikto/gobuster

skill_cards.if_condition: After identifying potential credentials from config files
skill_cards.then_action: Validate credentials against discovered services before attempting exploitation

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in early reconnaissance steps for SSH services
Consistent mapping results supported downstream decisions
